title: Fast test mode: tiers, --fast, --affected, --full in a git worktree with cached result (REQ-0096)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 timing report script and summary
AC2 config/test_tiers.json, --fast skips the slow tier
AC3 --affected maps changed files to tests, falls back to --fast
AC4 --full result file with tree hash, reused when unchanged
AC5 fast+slow = all tests, untagged runs in fast
AC7 known failures reported as known
AC8 --full in a throwaway git worktree in the background

design.summary: tools/run_tests.py with --fast/--affected/--full/--list; config/test_tiers.json (slow tests by id, known failures, map overrides, default fast); --full in a git worktree of HEAD in mkdtemp, background, result work/test-runs/<tree-hash>.json reused when unchanged; fast+slow == discover check; docs and role briefs say which mode when; hooks/settings enforcement excluded

implementation.summary: tools/run_tests.py (--fast/--affected/--full/--list/--time), config/test_tiers.json (20 slow ids, 4 known failures), --full in a git worktree of HEAD (mkdtemp, background, result cached by tree hash); measured: all 1752 = fast 1732 + slow 20; --fast 50.5 s vs 370 s full; --full 364 s with new=[] known=4 skipped=40; second --full REUSED

user_notes.note: run the suite in a git worktree like _code-security-scanner; --fast / skip heavy; best rule: --full once per task before VERIFIED, cached by tree hash
